non-blocking: the retirement was signed as receipt-only `supersede_exhausted_orphan` with no `successor_id`, while imas_codex/standard_names/source_invariant.py:190 (`supersede_names_losing_last_source`) already writes the `(successor)-[:REFINED_FROM]->(predecessor)` edge plus the StandardNameChange receipt, and the signed guard at imas_codex/standard_names/signed_manifest.py:3328-3355 refuses only while the predecessor still holds a bound path, so the refusal quoted at sib-rebind-removed-path-names.html:23 does not establish that no signed route carries the edge.
